description: Two dancers rock in and out and then swing, holding on throughout.

walkthrough.line: Take both hands with {who}, rock in and out, then close up and swing.
walkthrough.teach: Take both hands with {who} and rock: two steps in toward them, two steps back. That is the balance, four beats. Keep hold of the hand you have, close into a ballroom hold and buzz round for the rest of the phrase. Open out side by side, lark on the left.
